name: Dragon Bridge
kicker: The dragon bridge over the Han
summary: A 666-meter yellow dragon arches over the Han, and at 21:00 on Friday, Saturday, and Sunday its head breathes fire, then water, for the crowd on the bank. Watching is free. Come at dusk along the Bach Dang promenade, and do not wait for it on a weeknight.
getThere: Walk the Bach Dang promenade. The bridge links the center to the beach side.
heroCaption: The yellow dragon over the Han, in daylight

notice.title: No show on a weeknight
notice.body: The fire and water run at 21:00 on Friday, Saturday, Sunday, and major holidays only. During the fireworks festival the night can move.

body: Come at dusk and walk the promenade. The bridge is 666 meters and opened on 29 March 2013. On Friday, Saturday, Sunday, and major holidays the dragon breathes fire at 21:00, then water. The program lasts about 5 to 15 minutes, and watching from the bank is free.

Bach Dang is the walk that gets you there. On a show weekend the sidewalk fills, so arrive before 21:00. On a Monday, Tuesday, Wednesday, or Thursday there is no show, so do not plan the evening around one.

The east bank is the other place to stand. Since 1 August 2025 the Son Tra night market, once on Mai Hac De, has run on that bank, and the road in front closes to vehicles after 17:30. Eat there after the show.

figures.caption: The bridge lit at night, from the river path
figures.alt: Dragon Bridge at night, the head and arches lit and reflected in the Han River

gettingThere: The bridge crosses the Han between the center and the beach side. From a river hotel, walk Bach Dang. From My Khe the bridge is the crossing you already use.

legs.heading: From Bach Dang
legs.body: Walk the promenade. On a Friday, Saturday, or Sunday, be there before 21:00 if the fire is the reason.

legs.heading: From My Khe
legs.body: The bridge is the road back toward the center, by car or Grab.

hours: Show at 21:00 on Friday, Saturday, Sunday, and major holidays. Length: about 2 minutes of fire and 3 of water (city tourism portal); about 10–15 minutes for the program (Visit Da Nang). The bridge itself is a road.
closed: No show on an ordinary weeknight. During the fireworks festival the night can move. Son Tra night market closing hour at the east-bank site: check on arrival.
admissionNote: Free from the bank. Grandstand seating, if offered: check on arrival.
